Rail.description: Settlement rail. lightning and spark carry BTC; hedera carries HBAR.

CustodyType.description: Set by the server from the internal wallet record. A client never supplies it.

HexPublicKey.description: Lowercase hex public key: 32 bytes (64 hex) or a 33-byte compressed key (66 hex).

OpaqueId.description: Opaque printable ASCII identifier without spaces.

Bolt11.description: BOLT11 payment request, entirely lowercase or entirely uppercase (BOLT 11, Bech32); mixed case is rejected.

ReportedAmountMsat.description: Absolute wallet-reported amount in msat. Always positive; the direction gives the sign of the canonical amount.

ReportedAmountTinybar.description: Absolute wallet-reported amount in tinybar. Always positive.

SignedAmount.description: Canonical signed amount: positive for incoming, negative for outgoing.

FiatAmount.description: Fiat amount as a decimal string with at most two fraction digits; must be greater than zero.

FiatCurrency.description: ISO 4217 fiat currency code; Bitcoin units use amount_msat.

VerificationStatus.description: OPAGO verification status, separate from the wallet's final SDK status.

field.description: JSON pointer or header name of an invalid input.

ErrorDetails.description: Closed set of detail keys. A new key is a contract change (spec.md section 4).

message.description: Exact UTF-8 text to sign (spec.md 5.4). Its purpose, challenge_id and expires_at lines MUST equal the sibling fields; the server enforces this and the tests check it on the vectors.

Signature.description: Signature over the challenge message as printable ASCII without spaces. The algorithm and encoding per wallet source are an open question (spec.md, OQ-AUTH-1); the field stays opaque until then.

source_wallet_id.description: Immutable source identity (payment-registration-data-model.md, wallets): the Hedera account ID or the Spark identity public key. The network is not part of the governing identity key (OQ-BIND-6).

purpose.description: wallets.type (WalletType). Only INBOUND can register incoming and only OUTBOUND can register outgoing Path A payments; EXTERNAL and OTHER cannot register. Null for Spark and Hedera wallets (OQ-BIND-3).

BoundWallet.description: Wallet that bindWallet creates (spec.md section 6.2): Spark or Hedera, active, custody unknown until OQ-BIND-1.

anyOf.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

access_token.description: WalletBearer token. Format and lifetime: open question OQ-AUTH-2.

ActiveAddressBinding.description: createAddressBinding result (spec.md 6.3): a new active binding.

DeactivatedAddressBinding.description: deactivateAddressBinding result (spec.md 6.3): a deactivated binding with its time and reason.

anyOf.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

pos_id.description: Server-issued POS device ID (the LNbits device ID registered for the device). The POS never constructs it.

external_reference.description: Required, non-null device-local payment reference: the governing model stores it as client_reference, NOT NULL for channel pos, unique per device.

pos_id.description: Server-issued POS device ID (the LNbits device ID registered for the device). The POS never constructs it.

external_reference.description: Required, non-null device-local payment reference: the governing model stores it as client_reference, NOT NULL for channel pos, unique per device.

wallet_id.description: The registration wallet (for a POS registration, the wallet the device was bound to at registration). Path parameter of getWalletPayment.

amount_msat.description: Payable amount in msat. For a fiat registration it is fixed by each approved pre-check and is null until then. For an outgoing registration it is the amount encoded in the payment request.

amount.description: Requested fiat amount; null for an msat or outgoing registration.

currency.description: Requested fiat currency; null for an msat or outgoing registration.

pre_check_valid_until.description: Effective eligibility deadline of the current pre-check: the earlier of the stored preliminary_valid_until and checked_at + 24 hours; when the stored deadline is absent, checked_at + 24 hours (wallet-tme-shadow-mode.md, Path A). Always set for an ok pre-check.

transaction_id.description: First settlement of the registration (the canonical transaction that projected paid, or a late settlement after a terminal status); null while none exists. Read it with getWalletPayment.

SentRegistration.description: sendPayment result (spec.md 7.3): an outgoing registration with its reserved or dispatched PaymentCommand.

preimage.description: Validated transiently against payment_hash; never persisted; never proof of settlement.

provider_id.description: Provider of a provider payment ID; the empty string for Spark transfer IDs, Lightning request IDs, payment hashes and Hedera transaction IDs.

payment_path.description: path_a: registered payment; path_b: wallet-direct report; legacy: an existing LNbits row without registration lineage (payment-registration-data-model.md, transactions).

aliases.description: Every known alias. Empty only for legacy and path_a rows created before payment_identity_aliases existed (M8 step 4 has no backfill). A path_b payment has at least one alias.
